verdict.rationale: GitBook offers Git sync, a CLsI, and an authenticated write MCP server that could be scripted to make programmatic content changes across many pages, but there is no direct documentation of a bulk-edit/bulk-operations feature (e.g., mass tagging, batch permission changes, multi-page bulk edits) in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operations UI/API documentation, evidence of batch edits across many docs/pages in one action, independent confirmation of scale performance for bulk changes.
